about: FPAR 2.0 data element 3, provider role, from the NUCC taxonomy code on the encounter provider's user record (users.taxonomy). OpenEMR's physician_type list has only Physician among OPA's roles, so taxonomy is read instead, as the UDS Report's Table 5 map does. The first matching prefix wins; a taxonomy matching none is Other; no taxonomy is blank.
terms: CC0 1.0: our own mapping. NUCC taxonomy codes from https://taxonomy.nucc.org; the roles are OPA's (data/fpar2.json, provider_role).

rules.note: 367A: Advanced Practice Midwife (certified nurse-midwife); 176B: Midwife. Our reading: OPA's one midwife role covers both
